notes: WhaleChat 3.57.0 — chat is local-first and realtime: send is drawn from IndexedDB in ~6 ms with no network wait, receive rides one persistent realtime stream, and the outbox retries offline and drains automatically on reconnect. Presence is real: a 15 s heartbeat plus the open socket makes Online / Last seen update in under a second on the other device. Typing is real: debounced input flags reach the other participant over the same stream and show as animated dots in the chat, 'typing…' in the chat list and a 6 s auto-expiry. Delivered ticks now fire the moment the recipient's device is connected, read ticks when the thread is open. A stale saved server host can no longer break the app with "Failed to fetch": it is dropped and the build's own server is used.
